summary: Only the news agent was due and it found little: its newest verified item is the Nov 18 US close, so it tilts the two US indices slightly up and is silent elsewhere. History and papers agree on USDCAD and USDCHF up, and history and news agree on the oversold S&P 500 bouncing. The scanner gave no probabilities and flagged two-sided event risk for EUR, GBP, CAD and UK or European indices today (UK-EU summit, Moody's UK review, euro area confidence, Canadian retail sales). Next I want news to find dated FX, crypto and oil items, since coverage was empty for Nov 19 and 20.
